questions.question: You call wp_schedule_event() with interval 'every_fifteen_minutes' but the event never fires. Why?

options.label: WP-Cron only supports hourly or longer intervals
That interval name was never registered via cron_schedules
wp_schedule_event() requires manual triggering every time

feedback.correct: Right. wp_schedule_event() silently accepts any interval name — it only works if cron_schedules already registered a matching key.
feedback.incorrect: WP-Cron supports any interval length. The real cause: wp_schedule_event() was called with an interval name that cron_schedules never registered.
